criteria.description: Places stakeholders on a Power × Interest grid (or equivalent two-axis model) with the four engagement quadrants, not a flat list.
Gives a tailored plan per stakeholder/quadrant — what they care about, what they need, cadence, and channel — rather than one approach for all.
Identifies likely champions and blockers (with reasons) and a plan to enlist or address them.
Treats power and interest as distinct (e.g. recognizes a high-power/low-interest exec vs a low-power/high-interest contributor).
Notes that stakeholder positions can shift and should be revisited as the initiative evolves.
